name: Broke Bibliophiles Bangalore: BBB #100
description:
Well, we’ve somehow made it to 100 meetups.

A hundred afternoons of books, conversations, new faces, familiar faces, wildly differing opinions, recommendations that destroyed our TBRs, and the occasional discussion that wandered very far away from the book we started with.

So naturally, Meetup #100 deserves a little celebration.

This time, we’re getting together at Samagata Foundation for a slightly longer afternoon of books, games, food, conversation and general BBB chaos.

📍 Venue: Samagata Foundation
🕑 Date and Time: 11th October, 2026 . 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
📚 Meetup: Broke Bibliophiles Bangalore #100

We’re planning a few games, a lively bookish discussion, plenty of time to just hang out, and of course, snacks…err books.

More than anything, though, this one is about celebrating the community that has kept BBB going all the way to a hundred meetups.

Whether you’ve been coming for years, joined us recently, disappeared for twenty meetups and are planning your grand return, or have never attended a BBB meetup before, you’re very welcome.

If you’d like to come, pls RSVP here - https://forms.gle/Cd3joYXt9jvN19Ma9

Once RSVPed, pls transfer INR 250 to abhiram.ramesh@icici . This nominal fee is to help with the arrangement of the event and make it loads of fun for you! :)

Come with a book or thoughts about books you’ve read.
Come with opinions.
Come hungry.

See you at BBB #100. 📚🎉

For any queries, comment on this post or mail us at brokebibliophilesbangalore@gmail.com

We are also now re-active on Instagram thanks to Leah - one of our regulars and now our Insta Admin :) If you show up to the meetups, you can also have your reviews showcased on our Insta!
